categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in real estate development, focusing on residential and commercial building construction for sale and lease. It also involves land development, urban renewal projects, and operates a construction subsidiary. Additional activities include interior decoration, industrial plant development, and real estate brokerage services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced construction methods including Building Information Modeling (BIM) and innovative construction techniques to improve efficiency and quality. It integrates green building materials and sustainable design principles, emphasizing energy efficiency, carbon footprint reduction, and smart building technologies. ERP and BPM systems are used for resource planning and workflow management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are individual homebuyers, especially first-time and upgrading buyers, and commercial tenants. The company targets metropolitan areas with strong demand, including Taipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, and Tainan. It focuses on residential buyers with rigid demand and commercial clients in office and industrial sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in major metropolitan regions across Taiwan, including Taipei City, New Taipei City, Taoyuan City, Taichung City, Tainan City, and Miaoli County. The company also strategically develops land along high-speed rail and metro lines, expanding into emerging growth areas such as Miaoli.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain, focusing on land acquisition, development, construction, and sales. It owns a construction subsidiary to manage building projects, positioning itself as an integrated developer and builder with control over project execution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding project scale, deepening presence in key metropolitan and transit-oriented areas, and enhancing sustainable development through ESG initiatives. R&D focuses on green building technologies, smart building integration, and digital transformation of construction and management processes. The company also emphasizes risk management related to climate change and information security.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale and lease of residential and commercial properties developed by the company. Additional income comes from construction contracts via its subsidiary and real estate brokerage services. The company also benefits from land development gains and urban renewal projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other major Taiwanese real estate developers and construction firms, leveraging its strong brand, financial stability, and integrated construction capabilities. It holds a market share of approximately 1.29% among listed construction peers in Taiwan, positioning itself as a reputable mid-sized player with a focus on quality and sustainability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$6.1 billion in the latest fiscal year, a significant increase from the prior year, with net profit more than tripling. It maintains a stable equity base of around NT$10.5 billion and a manageable debt ratio near 63%. The workforce has grown modestly, supporting expanding operations and project deliveries.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, well-designed residential and commercial buildings with a focus on sustainability, smart technologies, and customer-centric features. It differentiates through integrated construction capabilities, rigorous quality control, and comprehensive after-sales service. Its commitment to ESG principles and urban renewal projects further enhances its competitive edge.
